components.category: Host data + Client UI plugin (4 tabs)

highlights.title: v1.4 — git-tree visual upgrade
points: stronger graph lines and larger, ringed nodes
color-coded kind pills and row hover states
branch accent bar on each version card

performance.title: Runtime notes
points: dashboard data is read once per plugin run and cached in memory
prior_probe_score is fully offline and deterministic (no model calls)
prior_probe_run is network-bound by the endpoint, one request per probe repeat

principles.title: Design principles
points: every dataset is a plain JSON file under data/, auditable with verify.js
UI reads theme tokens so light and dark modes render correctly
all views guard their data shape — a bad dataset degrades to an empty block, never a crash

compatibility.title: Compatibility
points: data directory is resolved by probing a candidate path list
self-check: run `node verify.js` at the repository root
